name: @intellectual-frontiers/terminal
description: The terminal as pure code: a typed command-line parser and command trees, the one palette of colour roles and marks, display width and cutting by columns, and a small terminal emulator for snapshot tests; no host, the same code on Bun, Node 26 and in a browser.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
